title: PikPak-Safe Cloud, Video Saver
summary: Fast downloads&secure cloud storage.Up to 10TB Private Cloud for all your files.
description:
PikPak – The private cloud that makes saving your favorite files fast, easy, and safe.
PikPak helps you save videos and photos from links, store files securely in the cloud, and manage all your content in one place. It supports smooth video playing and image preview, so you can access your saved content anytime.

PikPak is the perfect private cloud storage to store all your content. Whether it’s videos, photos, or documents, you can collect and save files easily from different sources. PikPak works as an all-in-one storage app for users who want to save content from apps and the web and keep everything organized in their cloud storage.

With support for Telegram bot integration, Facebook, and more, PikPak allows you to save videos from links or forward files directly into your cloud. All your saved videos, photos, and documents are stored safely and are easily accessible whenever you need them.

You can forward your favorite files to PikPak using the Telegram bot or save photos and videos through system sharing. Once saved, you can store files online, browse your library, and manage your cloud file storage seamlessly.

PikPak Highlights

Up to 10TB of Cloud Storage
Sign up to get 6GB of free secure cloud storage, and upgrade to a Premium plan to unlock up to 10TB of cloud storage for videos and files. PikPak lets you backup videos and photos without worrying about space, making it easy to store thousands of video files safely in the cloud.

Powerful Telegram Bot for Saving Content
Use the Telegram bot to save social media videos, forward links, and save content from apps like Telegram, Facebook, Twitter, TikTok, and more. The Telegram bot helps you save videos to cloud storage quickly and manage your files effortlessly.

Fast Cloud Transfer & File Saving
Enjoy fast and secure cloud transfer technology that helps you save videos from links and store files online without delays. PikPak ensures that all your saved files are transferred safely and remain protected in your private cloud storage.

Convenient Video and Image Preview
Preview videos and images directly in the app without downloading them first. PikPak works as an offline video saver and media manager, allowing you to check your saved content instantly while keeping everything stored securely in the cloud.

Organize with Folders
Create folders to organize your videos, photos, and documents. PikPak is a powerful cloud file manager that helps you keep your saved content structured and easy to find.

Why Choose PikPak?

Private Cloud Storage for All Your Content
PikPak is designed to be a secure private cloud where you can save videos, photos, and files safely. Your content stays private, protected, and always accessible in your cloud storage.

Fast and Easy File Management
Quickly save videos offline, organize files, and manage your cloud storage in one app. PikPak makes it easy to save videos and photos, whether they come from links, apps, or sharing.

Instant Access Anytime, Anywhere
Access your cloud storage for videos and files whenever you want. Browse, preview, and manage your saved content on the go with ease.

Built-in Browsing and Saving Experience
With PikPak’s built-in browser with save, you can browse and save videos or content while browsing, making it easy to collect everything you like in one place.

Quick Sign-In
Sign in using Google, Facebook, or email to start saving content instantly. PikPak helps you save files to cloud storage quickly and securely.

Install PikPak now for a smooth, fast, and secure file saving, cloud storage, and content management experience. Save videos and photos from links, manage your files easily, and enjoy a powerful all-in-one private cloud storage app.

If you have any questions about PikPak, please join the official PikPak user group:
https://t.me/pikpak_userservice

Or contact us at support@mypikpak.com
